2563 kalamos {kal'-am-os}

找不到和其相近的字; 陽性名詞

AV - reed 11, pen 1; 12

1) 蘆葦
2) 桿子 
3) 量尺 (#啟 11:1; 21:15|)
4) 蘆竿作的筆 (#約三 1:13|)
record.edic_text:
2563 kalamos {kal'-am-os}

or uncertain affinity;; n m

AV - reed 11, pen 1; 12

1) a reed
2) a staff made of a reed, a reed staff
3) a measuring reed or rod
4) a writer's reed, a pen

same.cexp: 蘆葦，桿；像杖一樣的量尺；筆
